name: CitationCard
summary: Source reference rendered next to an AI-generated value. Composes a small index ('Source 1'), source name, optional excerpt, optional confidence ring. Pairs with AISuggestion / AISummary outputs and with inline citations in prose. Distinct from a plain Link — CitationCard carries the AI provenance visual.

index.description: 1-indexed source number, rendered as a small pill before the title.

excerpt.description: 1-2 line quoted excerpt from the source. Italic, secondary.

url.description: Routes to the source. When set, the whole card becomes a link.

confidence.description: 0-100 — renders an inline AIBadge with the score.

rules: When url is set, the card is an <a> with aria-label='Source N, {source}, opens in new tab'.
Confidence renders inline AIBadge so SR users hear it as part of the card.
The excerpt is wrapped in <blockquote> so SR users hear 'quoted material'.

do: Always pair AI-generated values with at least one CitationCard.
Lead with index — '1' / '2' makes the source list scannable.
Use external link convention when url points outside the app.
Render confidence when the source is one of many.
dont: Don't combine an AI-generated value with NO citation. AI content without sources erodes trust.
Don't paint the entire card in lime fill — only the index pill picks up the accent tint.
